lawyer:
Mr. Md. Hefzul Bari, Advocate instructed by Mrs. Shahanara Begum Advocate-on-Record---------For the petitioners. 
Mr. Md. Zakir Hossain, Advocate, instructed by Mrs. Sufia Khatun, Advocate-on-Record---------For Respondent.

Agrani Bank Limited and Others
Vs.
Md. Alauddin Mollah
full_judgment: 5. Mr. Md. Hefzul Bari, learned Advocate appearing on behalf of the petitioners submitted that the Administrative Appellate Tribunal misdirected itself in accepting the aforesaid allegations of the respondent and disposing the appeal taking an imaginary erroneous view. The learned Advocate further submitted that the Administrative Appellate Tribunal on wholly erroneous consideration came to a wrong finding, without considering that the Tribunal below did not exercise its jurisdiction properly and exceeded its jurisdiction and failed to take into consideration evidence and materials in the case. He submitted that the Tribunals below wrongly held that the respondent had been imposed punishment for a second time by being involved in the process of recovery of loan of Roy Shaheb Bazar Branch, inasmuch as the respondent was not being punished for a second time under the provision of different law or separate rules, rather major punishment was imposed upon the respondent as stipulated in the service regulations which contemplate that the officer found guilty may be demoted by one rank and may be subjected to recovery of the financial loss in full or in part from his salary or otherwise and as such the impugned judgement is liable to be set aside. Ile submitted that the respondent's case is not maintainable under section 4(2) of the Administrative Tribunal Act, 1980 and it is barred by limitation, the respondent was suspended on 05.06.2005 and he filed departmental appeal on 08.10.2006 to opposite party No.1, which was rejected on 13.8.2007 and subsequently filed departmental review petition to the opposite party No.1 on 29.07.2008, which was rejected on 01.01.2009 which is not tenable under the provision of Agrani Bank Karmachari Chakuri Probidhan Mala-1995(the Probidhan Mala,1995). The Tribunal failed to exercise its mind upon this point, and therefore the judgement and orders of the Tribunals below are void, without jurisdiction and of no legal effect. The learned Advocate submitted that the allegations brought in the charge sheet against the respondent by the petitioner were proved upon inquiry and he was found guilty, therefore, he was suspended from service of the Bank in accordance with the provisions of the Probidhan Mala 1995. But the learned Members of the Tribunal failed to apply judicial mind on this point. Therefore, the judgement and order of the Tribunals are void, without jurisdiction and of no legal effect, which are liable to be set aside. He submitted that the respondent got opportunity of self-defense under the provisions of the Probidhan Mala, 1995. The whole proceeding was conducted under the provisions of the Probidhan Mala, 1995. But the learned members of the Tribunal wrongly stated in the judgement that the punishment was “সংবিধানের ৩৫(২) অনুচ্ছেদের পরিপন্থী. The impugned judgement and order was passed against the petitioners incorrectly and illegally, and therefore, the judgement and order is void and without jurisdiction and of no legal effect, and as such the same is liable to be set aside. The learned Advocate .submitted that the Administrative Appellate Tribunal passed the judgement and order on wholly erroneous and wrong findings of facts and circumstances, without discussing the case of the petitioners and also the evidence on record in its true perspective, and as such non-consideration of those rendered the impugned judgement and order as wholly illegal and unsustainable in law. He lastly submitted that the findings and decision of Tribunals below is fully misconceived and illegal and as such are liable to be set aside.
